title: Backup diagram for v_π
caption: Open circles are states, solid circles are state–action pairs. From the state s at the top, the policy chooses among actions; the environment answers each with a reward r and a next state s′. The Bellman equation averages over every path in this tree.

verification.note: Branching (three actions, two outcomes each) and labels as drawn on printed p. 72; the drawing is our own.
